blogPosts.title: How to Submit Clean Task Proofs That Get Approved Fast
blogPosts.excerpt: Follow three simple screenshot and timestamp habits to keep your approval rate near 100% and unlock faster payouts.
blogPosts.content:
Employers review dozens of worker proofs for every campaign. To get approved on the first check, always read the step-by-step instructions before clicking the external link.

When uploading a screenshot, make sure the required username, video watch timestamp, or confirmation banner is clearly visible without heavy cropping. Include your exact profile handle in the text proof box so the employer can match your action in seconds.

Avoid submitting duplicate or blurry images, as rejected tasks do not credit your Earning Balance and lower account trust.

blogPosts.title: Launching High-Retention App Testing & Video Campaigns
blogPosts.excerpt: Structure micro-job instructions clearly so verified community testers deliver actionable feedback and genuine engagement.
blogPosts.content:
Great micro-job campaigns combine clear instructions with realistic verification checks. Start by breaking your task into 3 to 4 numbered steps.

Instead of vague instructions, specify exactly what the worker should share in the proof field—such as a 2-sentence UX observation or a confirmation code from your thank-you screen. Our escrow system holds your campaign budget safely and only releases funds for proofs you approve.

blogPosts.title: Instant bKash, Nagad & Binance USDT Payout Guide 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything you need to know about minimum withdrawal thresholds, gateway fees, and earning-to-deposit wallet transfers.
blogPosts.content:
Once your Earning Balance reaches the minimum threshold configured in our payment gateways, head to Wallet & Payouts inside your dashboard.

Choose bKash, Nagad, Binance Pay / USDT (TRC20), or PayPal, double-check your receiving account number, and submit your request. Want to advertise your own channel or website? Use the instant Transfer tab to move funds from your Earning Balance into your Deposit Balance with zero delay.

pages.title: About Us
pages.summary: Learn how MiniWorkers connects verified human freelancers with digital creators and growing businesses.
pages.content:
MiniWorkers is a human-verified micro-job marketplace built for both everyday earners and campaign advertisers.

Workers complete straightforward digital assignments—from video feedback and social engagement to app usability checks—and withdraw earnings through trusted local and global payment gateways.

Employers launch targeted campaigns with full proof inspection before any reward is released.

pages.title: Terms & Rules
pages.summary: Fair-use marketplace guidelines protecting workers, employers, and payout integrity.
pages.content:
1. One Verified Account Per User: Creating multiple accounts to abuse referral bonuses or repeat single-slot tasks is prohibited.

2. Honest Proof Submissions: Workers must complete every step before uploading screenshots. Automated scripts or fake proofs lead to rejection or suspension.

3. Fair Employer Review: Employers must approve accurate proofs promptly. Unfair rejections can be disputed via Support Tickets for Admin review.

pages.title: Payout Policy
pages.summary: Deposit verification timelines, withdrawal processing windows, and KYC guidelines.
pages.content:
Deposits submitted with a valid Transaction ID (TrxID) or payment hash are verified by our finance administrators and credited directly to your Deposit Balance.

Withdrawals from your Earning Balance are queued via bKash, Nagad, Binance USDT, or PayPal and processed promptly once account details and optional KYC verification are confirmed.
